notes: Setup: the sandbox had Node v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24+; installed Node v24.22.3 from nodejs.org (sha256 checked) in the scratchpad (~10s). Bootstrap npm,submodule,reference with --allow-unpinned-reference took 232s (submodule 7.5s, reference build most of the rest). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+video-operator-registry test: 72s, green (8 tests).
The differential file runs in about 6s with --maxWorkers=1; the unit file in under 1s.
No case is linux-gated: the 8-bit path is one double multiply plus lrint per table entry, then integer sums and av_clip_uintp2.
A mutation replacing ties-to-even with Math.round fails 6 of the 8 differential tests.
pa is parsed and range-checked but has no effect with pc=none, matching native filter_slice[0].

Native negotiates every one of the 17 negotiation sources to a format with storage (gray/YUV -> rgb24, yuva420p -> argb), so registry examples need no format= prefix; two use one anyway to cover gbrp, rgba and rgb24.
